title: Box3D WebGPU v1.12 native dynamic-index and explosion-rejection benchmark

methodology.sourceFrozenComparison: exact v1.11 source archive public/box3d JS+WASM versus current public/box3d JS+WASM
methodology.balancedOrder: 12 AB and 12 BA samples per case
methodology.calibration: baseline pilot doubles/projects a shared repeat count until the timed batch approaches the target; both variants then use exactly that repeat count
methodology.statistic: median milliseconds per operation with MAD
methodology.confidence: 20,000-resample deterministic stratified balanced-order paired bootstrap of medians
methodology.correctness: bit-exact Float32 matrix and color streams, replay hashes, body/dynamic/awake counts, max-body counter, and transform/color revisions after sync, definite-miss and near-field explosions, steps, kick, projectile, and rain
methodology.timerFloorPolicy: no per-call claim is accepted unless both variants execute a calibrated batch whose median duration is at least half the target
methodology.classification: accepted only when the confidence lower bound exceeds 1.03x; otherwise >=0.95x point estimate is reported as parity/control, never as a win
